subject.title: fix: preserve fallback routes across alias resolution

question: Should OpenClaw accept persisted route-resolution provenance as the canonical upgrade-safe boundary for preserving selected fallback routes across recovered sessions and deferred runs?
rationale: The patch deliberately changes how persisted provider/model override pairs are interpreted after upgrade; tests cover legacy automatic-fallback recovery, but maintainers must confirm this is the permanent session contract rather than a narrower resolver-only repair.

options.title: Adopt canonical route provenance
options.body: Accept the end-to-end marker after a current-main rebase and focused fresh-plus-upgrade verification of raw aliases and recovered fallback sessions.

options.title: Narrow to the resolver
options.body: Replace the persisted provenance approach with a resolver-local precedence repair, accepting weaker protection across deferred and recovered execution paths.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical route provenance
recommendation.body: Accept the end-to-end marker after a current-main rebase and focused fresh-plus-upgrade verification of raw aliases and recovered fallback sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The replacement PR frames and implements the end-to-end ownership model that requires confirmation.
